entities.name: Mitsunobu aryl etherification
observations: Primary alcohol and p-cresol undergo dehydrative O-alkylation to form a p-tolyl ether; no C–C bond formation is indicated.
The closest exact precedents use triphenylphosphine and diethyl azodicarboxylate in THF.

entities.name: Triphenylphosphine
observations: Likely Mitsunobu reagent used with DEAD to activate the primary alcohol.

entities.name: Diethyl azodicarboxylate
observations: Likely Mitsunobu azo reagent paired with triphenylphosphine.

entities.name: THF solvent
observations: Tetrahydrofuran is the solvent reported in the closest reaction precedents.

entities.name: p-Cresol
observations: Phenolic nucleophile; its oxygen becomes part of the aryl ether product.
